title: 2025 Annual Crime Report: Operational Shift and Measurable Outcomes
description:
Hello Santa Monica,

This video provides an overview of 2025 crime data, along with a look at several significant incidents that shaped public safety efforts throughout the year. You will hear directly from our personnel and Chief Darrick Jacob as they walk through key trends, operational changes, and what the data reflects about how the department is working.

We appreciate you taking the time to stay informed. SMPD remains committed to transparency, accountability, and continued collaboration with our community as we work to build trust and maintain public safety.

For more visit: https://www.santamonica.gov/blog/2025-annual-crime-report-operational-shift-and-measurable-outcomes
